{"id":2016197921,"question_id":3606,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month, 3 weeks","timestamp":1780040141,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2016197921/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Element After Replacement With Digit Sum","memory":"27.7 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minElement(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int mini = INT_MAX;\n        for(auto it : nums)\n        {\n            int sum = 0;\n            while(it > 0) \n            {\n                sum += (it % 10);\n                it /= 10;\n            }\n            mini = min(mini , sum);\n        }\n        return mini;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-element-after-replacement-with-digit-sum","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2038}
